rows.analysis: 此字為複數形名詞，源自 pantaloons 的縮短與複數化（源於義大利語 Pantalone 劇中角色名所穿的長褲）。在北美英語中主要指長褲，而在英式英語中則常指內褲。
rows.definition: 1. an outer garment covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg; 2. underpants worn beneath outer clothing.

example.eng: He is wearing a blue shirt and black pants.
example.ch: 他穿著一件藍色襯衫和黑色長褲。

example.eng: Make sure to change your socks and pants every day.
example.ch: 確保每天更換襪子和內褲。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，經由古法語與拉丁語 papyrus（源自希臘語 πάπυρος 紙莎草）進入英語，指由植物纖維製成的薄片物質，進而延伸指報紙、文件、考卷及學術論文。
rows.definition: 1. material manufactured in thin sheets from the pulp of wood or other fibrous substances, used for writing, drawing, or wrapping; 2. a piece of paper with information written or printed on it, such as a document or test; 3. a daily or weekly publication containing news and articles; 4. a written essay or research report on a particular topic.

example.eng: She wrote her phone number down on a piece of paper.
example.ch: 她把電話號碼寫在一張紙上。

example.eng: Please submit your homework paper by tomorrow morning.
example.ch: 請在明天早上前交出你的作業試卷。

example.eng: He reads the morning paper while drinking coffee.
example.ch: 他一邊喝咖啡一邊讀早報。

example.eng: The professor published a new academic paper on linguistics.
example.ch: 這位教授發表了一篇關於語言學的新學術論文。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 parens（動詞 parere「生養、產生」的現在分詞），指生養孩子的父親或母親。
rows.definition: 1. a father or mother.

example.eng: Both parents attended the school meeting yesterday.
example.ch: 雙親昨天都參加了學校會議。

rows.analysis: 此字為 parent 的複數形名詞，指父親和母親雙親二人，常用於家庭或學校情境中。
rows.definition: 1. a father and mother together.

example.eng: She loves her parents very much.
example.ch: 她非常愛她的父母。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，透過古法語借自日耳曼語族，原意指圍起來供狩獵的林地，現代則演變為供公眾遊憩的都市公園。
rows.definition: 1. a large public area of land with grass, trees, and recreation facilities.

example.eng: The children are playing football in the park.
example.ch: 孩子們正在公園裡踢足球。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，由名詞 park（原指將車馬停放在特定保留區）轉品而來，指將車輛暫時停放在指定位置。
rows.definition: 1. bring a vehicle that one is driving to a halt and leave it temporarily.

example.eng: He parked his car right in front of the store.
example.ch: 他把車停在商店正前方。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 pars（分、部），指整體當中的一部分，並延伸出機械零件及戲劇角色的義項。
rows.definition: 1. some but not all of a thing; a portion; 2. a piece or segment that fits with others to make a machine or structure; 3. a character in a play, movie, or broadcast.

example.eng: I spent a large part of the day reading books.
example.ch: 我花了一天的大部分時間讀書。

example.eng: The mechanic had to replace a broken engine part.
example.ch: 機械師必須更換一個壞掉的引擎零件。

example.eng: She played a minor part in the school drama.
example.ch: 她在學校戲劇中扮演一個小角色。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 partire（分割、分配）的派生詞，原指「分出的派別或團體」，後演變出社交聚會、政黨以及法律契約當事人的義項。
rows.definition: 1. a social gathering of guests for conversation, food, and drinks; 2. an organized political group that seeks to capture political power; 3. a person or group forming one side of an agreement or dispute.

example.eng: We are planning a surprise birthday party for our friend.
example.ch: 我們正在為朋友策劃一個驚喜生日派對。

example.eng: Both political parties agreed to discuss the new tax law.
example.ch: 兩個政黨都同意討論新的稅法。

example.eng: All parties involved in the contract must sign it.
example.ch: 合約中涉及的所有當事人必須簽署。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，源自拉丁語 passus（步伐），經法語演變而來，核心義為「跨越、走過」，並引申出考試及格與傳遞物品的用法。
rows.definition: 1. move past or by; go beyond; 2. succeed in an examination, test, or course; 3. transfer something from one person to another.

example.eng: He passed the post office on his way to work.
example.ch: 他去上班的路上經過了郵局。

example.eng: She studied hard and passed her driving test.
example.ch: 她努力讀書並通過了駕照考試。

example.eng: Please pass the salt to me.
example.ch: 請把鹽遞給我。

rows.analysis: 此字為不及物動詞，表示不接直接受詞的移動或時間的消逝。
rows.definition: 1. move in a specified direction or go by; 2. elapse or go by in time.

example.eng: Many cars passed by while we were waiting.
example.ch: 我們等待時有許多車輛開過去。

example.eng: Time seems to pass so quickly during the holidays.
example.ch: 假期中時間似乎過得飛快。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，源自動詞 pass 的過去分詞轉品，用來修飾時間上已經發生的事物。
rows.definition: 1. gone by in time and no longer existing; previous.

example.eng: In past years, this town was much quieter.
example.ch: 在過去幾年裡，這個城鎮安靜得多。

rows.analysis: 此字為介系詞，源自動詞 pass，表示在空間上超越或在時間上超過某個點。
rows.definition: 1. beyond in time, space, or degree.

example.eng: It is already past ten o'clock at night.
example.ch: 晚上已經過十點了。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，源自古法語 paier（源自拉丁語 pacare「使平息、滿足」），引申為滿足債務需求而「支付金錢」，或付出注意力。
rows.definition: 1. give money that is due for goods, services, or a debt; 2. give or expend something such as attention or respect.

example.eng: I need to pay the electricity bill today.
example.ch: 我今天得繳電費。

example.eng: Please pay attention to the teacher's instructions.
example.ch: 請注意聽老師的指示。

rows.analysis: 此字為不及物動詞，表示進行付款的動作而不帶直接受詞。
rows.definition: 1. give money to settle a debt or purchase something.

example.eng: Will you pay by cash or credit card?
example.ch: 你要付現還是刷卡？

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，由動詞 pay 加上名詞字尾 -ment 構成，指付款的行為或所支付的金額。
rows.definition: 1. the action of paying someone or of being paid; the amount of money paid.

example.eng: We accept cash and credit card payments.
example.ch: 我們接受現金和信用卡付款。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞。作為「筆」時，源自拉丁語 penna（羽毛），因早期以鳥羽製成筆；作為「欄舍」時，為日耳曼語源的古英語字，指圍欄。
rows.definition: 1. an instrument for writing or drawing with ink; 2. a small enclosure for farm animals.

example.eng: He signed the document with a black ink pen.
example.ch: 他用黑色墨水筆簽署了文件。

example.eng: The farmer led the sheep back into the pen.
example.ch: 農夫把羊群帶回欄舍裡。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古法語 pencel，最終源自拉丁語 peniculus（小尾巴、畫刷），在中世紀指藝術家的細畫刷，後來演變為書寫用的鉛筆。
rows.definition: 1. an instrument for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin cylinder of graphite enclosed in wood.

example.eng: She made a sketch of the house with a pencil.
example.ch: 她用鉛筆畫了這棟房子的草圖。

rows.analysis: 此字為複數同形集體名詞，源自古法語 peuple，源於拉丁語 populus（人民），作為一般群眾或特定民族的統稱。
rows.definition: 1. human beings in general or considered collectively; 2. the members of a particular nation, community, or ethnic group.

example.eng: Many people were waiting outside the concert hall.
example.ch: 許多人在音樂廳外等待。

example.eng: Canada is a country made up of many different peoples.
example.ch: 加拿大是由許多不同民族組成的國家。

rows.analysis: 此字為副詞，由介系詞 per 與複數名詞 haps（機會、運氣，源自古諾斯語）組合而成，字面義為「依機會而定」，現代表示「也許」。
rows.definition: 1. used to express uncertainty or possibility; maybe.

example.eng: Perhaps we can visit the museum tomorrow.
example.ch: 也許我們明天可以參觀博物館。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 persona（面具、戲劇角色、人物），經古法語進入英語，指單一個體的人。
rows.definition: 1. a human being regarded as an individual.

example.eng: She is a very kind and helpful person.
example.ch: 她是一個非常善良且樂於助人的人。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，起源於16世紀方言，原指受溺愛的寵兒，後專指飼養在家中陪伴的動物。
rows.definition: 1. a domestic or tamed animal kept for companionship or pleasure.

example.eng: They keep a cute dog as a pet.
example.ch: 他們養了一隻可愛的狗作為寵物。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，為現代透明構詞，由希臘語字根 phōs（光，屬格 photos）與 graphē（書寫、記錄）結合而成，字面義為「以光描繪」。
rows.definition: 1. a picture made using a camera, in which an image is focused on light-sensitive material and made visible.

example.eng: He showed me an old photograph of his grandfather.
example.ch: 他給我看一張他祖父的舊相片。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，是 photograph 的日常口語截短形式（clipping），意義與用法完全相同但更為簡便。
rows.definition: 1. a photograph.

example.eng: She took a photo of the sunset with her phone.
example.ch: 她用手機拍了一張日落的照片。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自義大利語 fortepiano 的簡稱，字面原意為「強弱」（fortis「強」+ planus/piano「輕柔」），因該樂器能透過觸鍵力度發出強弱不同的聲音而得名。
rows.definition: 1. a large keyboard musical instrument played by pressing keys that cause hammers to strike strings.

example.eng: She has been learning to play the piano for two years.
example.ch: 她學彈鋼琴已經兩年了。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，源自日耳曼語源的古英語 pician，本義與尖銳工具或用手指掐取有關，引申為採摘花果及挑選人事物。
rows.definition: 1. choose someone or something from a number of alternatives; 2. pluck or harvest flowers, fruit, or vegetables from a plant.

example.eng: You can pick any book you like from the shelf.
example.ch: 你可以從書架上挑選任何你喜歡的書。

example.eng: The children love to pick fresh strawberries in the garden.
example.ch: 孩子們喜歡在花園裡摘新鮮草莓。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自法語 pique-nique，由動詞 piquer（挑、撿）與 nique（小東西、無價值之物）組成，原指各人帶食物聚餐的活動，後泛指野餐。
rows.definition: 1. an excursion or outing in which people take food to be eaten outdoors.

example.eng: We packed some sandwiches and went for a picnic by the lake.
example.ch: 我們準備了一些三明治，去湖邊野餐。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 pictura（繪畫、描繪，源於 pingere「繪畫」），指視覺上的繪畫或照片，也引申為抽象的整體情勢。
rows.definition: 1. a painting, drawing, or photograph on a surface; 2. a representation or description of a situation.

example.eng: She drew a beautiful picture of a cat.
example.ch: 她畫了一張漂亮的貓咪圖片。

example.eng: The financial report gives a clear picture of the company's success.
example.ch: 這份財務報告清楚呈現了公司的營運局勢。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，可能源自 magpie（喜鵲，因其巢內雜亂多料，類似傳統肉派內餡豐富雜聚），指外層有酥皮包裹餡料的烘焙食品。
rows.definition: 1. a baked dish of fruit, meat, or vegetables, typically with a top and base of pastry.

example.eng: My grandmother baked a delicious apple pie for dessert.
example.ch: 我祖母烤了一個美味的蘋果派當甜點。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古法語 piece，最終源自晚期拉丁語 pettia（塊、碎片），指從整體中分割出來的一部分。
rows.definition: 1. a portion or quantity of something taken from a larger whole.

example.eng: He cut a large piece of cake for me.
example.ch: 他為我切了一大塊蛋糕。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自日耳曼語源的中低地德語或古英語擬音，指家豬或野豬。
rows.definition: 1. an omnivorous hoofed mammal with sparse bristly hair and a flat snout, kept for its meat.

example.eng: The farmer feeds the pigs every morning at sunrise.
example.ch: 農夫每天日出時餵豬。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自日耳曼語源的古英語 spinnel 或拉丁語 spina（刺），指細長尖銳的金屬固定針或徽章。
rows.definition: 1. a thin piece of metal with a sharp point, used for fastening things together or as a badge.

example.eng: She used a pin to fasten the ribbon to her dress.
example.ch: 她用別針把絲帶固定在裙子上。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，原指石竹科植物（pinks）的花朵顏色，後轉為指這種淡紅帶白的色彩。
rows.definition: 1. of a pale red color.

example.eng: She wore a lovely pink dress to the party.
example.ch: 她穿了一件可愛的粉紅色洋裝去參加派對。

rows.analysis: 此字或擬聲源自拉丁語 pipare（發出尖叫或鳥鳴聲），因古代樂管或發聲管而得名，後泛指輸送流體的管道及吸煙用的煙斗。
rows.definition: 1. a long tube through which liquids or gases can flow; 2. a small device for smoking tobacco, consisting of a tube and a bowl.

example.eng: A water pipe burst in the basement yesterday.
example.ch: 地下室昨天有一根水管破裂了。

example.eng: The old man sat on the porch smoking his pipe.
example.ch: 老人坐在走廊上抽著煙斗。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 platea（寬闊的街道、廣場），經希臘語與古法語演變，指空間中的特定地點。
rows.definition: 1. a particular position, point, or area in space; a location.

example.eng: This park is a wonderful place to relax on weekends.
example.ch: 這個公園是週末放鬆的好地方。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自法語 plan（源於拉丁語 planta「足底、平面圖」），指事先擬定的行動方案或建築平面圖。
rows.definition: 1. a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something; 2. a map or diagram of a building or area.

example.eng: We need to make a solid plan for our summer vacation.
example.ch: 我們需要為暑假擬定一個具體的計畫。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，由名詞 plan 轉品而來，指預先籌劃或安排某事。
rows.definition: 1. decide on and arrange in advance ethnically or systematically.

example.eng: They are planning a trip to Japan next month.
example.ch: 他們正計畫下個月去日本旅行。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古法語 planete，源於希臘語 πλανήτης（planētēs「漫游者」），因古人發現恆星位置相對固定，而行星在星空中會移動而得名。
rows.definition: 1. a celestial body moving in an elliptical orbit round a star.

example.eng: Earth is the third planet from the sun.
example.ch: 地球是距離太陽第三近的行星。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 planta（足底、栽種的幼苗），名詞演變出植物及大型工業設備廠房的義項。
rows.definition: 1. a living organism of the kind that grows in a permanent site, absorbing water and inorganic substances; 2. a place where an industrial or manufacturing process takes place.

example.eng: She waters the potted plants on her balcony every morning.
example.ch: 她每天早上幫陽台上的盆栽澆水。

example.eng: The city built a new water treatment plant.
example.ch: 這個城市建造了一座新的水力處理廠。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，源自拉丁語 plantare（插入土中栽種），指將植物或樹木種植在土壤中。
rows.definition: 1. place a seed, plant, or cutting in the ground so that it can grow.

example.eng: We planted several tomato seeds in the backyard.
example.ch: 我們在後院種了幾顆番茄種子。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古法語 plate（平坦的金屬片），最初指金屬盤，後泛指盛食物的平盤及車輛的金屬號牌。
rows.definition: 1. a flat dish, typically round, used for eating or serving food; 2. a thin, flat piece of metal, often bearing a number or name.

example.eng: Please put the plates on the dining table.
example.ch: 請把盤子放到餐桌上。

example.eng: The police noted down the car's license plate number.
example.ch: 警察記下了汽車的車牌號碼。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，由動詞 play 轉品而來，指戲劇演出或遊戲活動。
rows.definition: 1. a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage; 2. activity engaged in for enjoyment.

example.eng: We went to see a Shakespearean play last night.
example.ch: 我們昨晚去看了莎士比亞的戲劇。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，接直接受詞表示進行遊戲、扮演戲劇角色或播放影音檔案。
rows.definition: 1. act the role of a character in a play or movie; 2. cause music or a recording to be heard on a machine.

example.eng: She played the role of Juliet in the drama club.
example.ch: 她在戲劇社中扮演茱麗葉的角色。

example.eng: Can you play that song for me again?
example.ch: 你可以再幫我播一次那首歌嗎？

rows.analysis: 此字為不及物動詞，源自日耳曼語源的古英語 pleġan（嬉戲、活動），引申為兒童遊戲、體育競技及音樂演奏。
rows.definition: 1. engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose; 2. perform music on an instrument; 3. take part in a sport or game.

example.eng: The little kids are playing happily in the sandbox.
example.ch: 小孩子們正在沙坑裡快樂地玩耍。

example.eng: He plays the violin in the school orchestra.
example.ch: 他在學校樂團裡拉小提琴。

example.eng: Do you want to play basketball this afternoon?
example.ch: 你今天下午想打籃球嗎？

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，由動詞 play 加上 agent 名詞字尾 -er 構成，指參與運動比賽的選手或播放音樂的機器。
rows.definition: 1. a person who takes part in a sport or game; 2. an electronic device that plays recorded music or video.

example.eng: He is one of the best basketball players in the league.
example.ch: 他是聯盟裡最好的籃球運動員之一。

example.eng: I bought a new digital audio player yesterday.
example.ch: 我昨天買了一台新的數位音訊播放器。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，源自拉丁語 placere（使人滿意、喜悅），經古法語進入英語。
rows.definition: 1. cause to feel happy and satisfied.

example.eng: She always tries her best to please her parents.
example.ch: 她總是盡最大努力讓父母高興。

rows.analysis: 此字為感嘆詞，源自「if it please you（如果你高興、若蒙允許）」的短句省略，現代用作禮貌請求的語助詞。
rows.definition: 1. used in polite requests or commands.

example.eng: Please close the door when you leave.
example.ch: 你離開時請把門關上。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，由動詞 please 加上名詞字尾 -ure 構成，指感到高興或滿足的狀態。
rows.definition: 1. a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment.

example.eng: It is a great pleasure to meet you today.
example.ch: 今天能見到您真是極大的樂事。

rows.analysis: 此縮寫源自拉丁語 post meridiem（意即 after noon「中午之後」），用來標示中午12點到午夜12點之間的時間。
rows.definition: 1. forming part of the time from noon to midnight.

example.eng: The train is scheduled to arrive at 3:30 pm.
example.ch: 火車預定在下午3點30分到達。

rows.analysis: 此為 pm 的帶標點拼寫形式，同樣源自拉丁語 post meridiem（午后），用法與含義完全相同。
rows.definition: 1. forming part of the time from noon to midnight.

example.eng: Our office closes at 6:00 p.m. on weekdays.
example.ch: 我們辦公室在平日下午6點關門。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古法語 poche（袋子）的小稱形式，指縫在衣服上用來裝小物品的小袋。
rows.definition: 1. a small bag sewn into or on clothing, used for carrying small items.

example.eng: He put his hands deep into his coat pockets.
example.ch: 他把雙手深深插進外套口袋裡。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自拉丁語 punctum（刺孔、點，源於 pungere「刺」），經古法語進入英語，本義為尖端或小圓點，引申為計分點與議論要點。
rows.definition: 1. a small dot or mark, or the tapering sharp end of something; 2. a unit of scoring in a game or competition; 3. a particular detail, idea, or argument in a discussion.

example.eng: Draw a small point at the center of the circle.
example.ch: 在圓心畫一個小點。

example.eng: Our basketball team won by three points.
example.ch: 我們籃球隊贏了三分。

example.eng: I see your point, but I still disagree.
example.ch: 我明白你的要點，但我仍然不同意。

rows.analysis: 此字為及物動詞，由名詞 point 轉品而來，指用手指或器具指向某方向或目標。
rows.definition: 1. direct one's finger or something else towards an object in order to show where it is.

example.eng: He pointed his finger at the map on the wall.
example.ch: 他用手指著牆上的地圖。

rows.analysis: 此字為複數同形集體名詞，源自希臘語 politeia（國家、公民行政），經法語進入英語，指維護社會秩序與法律的警察部隊。
rows.definition: 1. the civil force of a state, responsible for maintaining public order and preventing and detecting crime.

example.eng: The police arrived at the scene of the accident quickly.
example.ch: 警察迅速到達事故現場。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，源自拉丁語 politus（擦亮的、文雅的，動詞 polire 的過去分詞），引申為行為舉止文雅、有禮貌。
rows.definition: 1. having or showing good manners; courteous.

example.eng: It is polite to say thank you when someone helps you.
example.ch: 當別人幫忙時說謝謝是很有禮貌的。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，為 pound（水壩、蓄水池）的變體，指比湖泊小的天然或人工蓄水池塘。
rows.definition: 1. a small body of still water, either natural or artificial.

example.eng: Several ducks are swimming peacefully in the pond.
example.ch: 幾隻鴨子正在池塘裡平靜地游著。

rows.analysis: 此字為名詞，源自古英語 pol，指小積水處或人工游泳池，後延伸出資源或資金集中的「共用池」義項。
rows.definition: 1. a small area of standing water, or an artificial basin filled with water for swimming; 2. a shared supply of resources, money, or staff.

example.eng: The children love swimming in the outdoor pool during summer.
example.ch: 孩子們夏天很喜歡在戶外游泳池游泳。

example.eng: The company set up a carpool to save travel costs.
example.ch: 公司設立了共乘車隊以節省交通成本。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，源自拉丁語 pauper（貧乏的），經古法語進入英語，指經濟狀況貧困，或品質低劣、處境堪憐。
rows.definition: 1. lacking sufficient money to live at a standard considered comfortable or normal; 2. of a low or inferior standard or quality, or deserving pity.

example.eng: They donated food and clothes to help poor families.
example.ch: 他們捐贈食物和衣服來幫助貧困家庭。

example.eng: The team lost the game due to poor performance.
example.ch: 球隊因為表現不佳而輸了比賽。

rows.analysis: 此字為複合名詞，由 pop（爆裂聲）與 corn（玉米）結合而成，指加熱會爆開的玉米粒點心。
rows.definition: 1. corn kernels that are heated until they burst open and form light, fluffy snack pieces.

example.eng: We bought a large bucket of popcorn before watching the movie.
example.ch: 我們在看電影前買了一大桶爆米花。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，源自拉丁語 popularis（屬於人民的，源自 populus「人民」），原指受平民喜愛的，現泛指廣受喜愛或流行的事物。
rows.definition: 1. liked or admired by many people or by a particular group; 2. suited to or intended for the general public.

example.eng: Soccer is one of the most popular sports in the world.
example.ch: 足球是世界上最受歡迎的運動之一。

rows.analysis: 此字為形容詞，源自拉丁語 possibilis（可能做到的，源於 posse「能夠」），指有機會發生或做到的。
rows.definition: 1. able to be done or achieved; having a chance of happening or being true.

example.eng: We will try our best to finish the project as soon as possible.
example.ch: 我們會盡最大努力盡快完成這個專案。
